explain.validRoot: Contour accepted the proxy and serves the host {{fqdn}}.
explain.validRootWarnings: Contour accepted the proxy and serves the host {{fqdn}}, with the warnings below.
explain.validIncluded: Contour accepted the proxy: a root proxy includes it, and its routes are served under that root's host.
explain.validIncludedWarnings: Contour accepted the proxy, with the warnings below: a root proxy includes it, and its routes are served under that root's host.
explain.orphaned: No root HTTPProxy includes this proxy, so Contour ignores it. Include it from a root proxy (spec.includes), or give it a virtualhost to make it a root.
explain.pending: No Contour has processed this proxy yet: Contour is not running, or the proxy belongs to another Contour.
explain.pendingClass: No Contour has processed this proxy yet: Contour is not running, or no Contour serves the ingress class {{class}}.
explain.invalid: Contour rejected the proxy ({{reason}}). The errors below say what to fix.
explain.invalidInPart: Contour serves the proxy in part ({{reason}}): the parts named below are left out, and requests to them get a 502 or 503 response.
explain.duplicateVhost: Another HTTPProxy uses the same host {{fqdn}}, so Contour serves neither of them ({{reason}}).
explain.rootNamespace: Contour does not accept root proxies in this namespace ({{reason}}): it is started with --root-namespaces, which Sextant cannot see. Move the root to one of those namespaces, or make this proxy an included one.
explain.includeCycle: The includes form a cycle ({{reason}}), so Contour serves none of this proxy's routes.
explain.delegationNotPermitted: The TLS Secret is in another namespace, and no TLSCertificateDelegation there lets this namespace use it ({{reason}}).
explain.secretNotValid: The TLS Secret is missing or holds no valid certificate ({{reason}}).
explain.noFqdn: The virtualhost names no fqdn ({{reason}}): a root proxy needs a host.
explain.nothingDefined: The proxy has no routes, includes or tcpproxy ({{reason}}).
explain.extensionInvalid: Contour does not accept this extension service ({{reason}}): proxies that use it fail their authorization or rate limit checks.

fields.delegationNotServed: The cluster does not serve TLSCertificateDelegation.
fields.delegationUnknown: The TLSCertificateDelegations of the Secret's namespace cannot be read.
fields.delegationMissing: No TLSCertificateDelegation in namespace {{namespace}} lets namespace {{target}} use this Secret.

routes.title: Routes
routes.mirror: Mirror: a copy of {{percent}}% of requests
routes.noService: No service: requests get a 503 response

tree.title: Delegation tree
tree.rootIncluded: A root cannot be included: Contour answers 502
tree.failed: The HTTPProxies of the cluster cannot be read, so the delegation tree is not known.
tree.noRoot: No root HTTPProxy includes this proxy.
tree.truncated: The cluster has more HTTPProxies than Sextant reads at once: the tree may be incomplete.

delegations.explain: Lets HTTPProxies of the target namespaces use these Secrets of this namespace as their TLS certificate (written as namespace/name in spec.virtualhost.tls.secretName).

diagnose.orphaned: No root HTTPProxy includes {{name}}, so Contour ignores it.
diagnose.orphanedWhy: A proxy without a virtualhost is served only through a root proxy that includes it (spec.includes).
diagnose.pending: No Contour has processed HTTPProxy {{name}} yet: Contour is not running, or the proxy belongs to another Contour.
diagnose.pendingClass: No Contour has processed HTTPProxy {{name}} yet: Contour is not running, or no Contour serves the ingress class {{class}}.
diagnose.invalidInPart: Contour serves HTTPProxy {{name}} in part ({{reason}}): the failing parts are found below.
diagnose.rootNamespaces: Contour accepts root proxies only in the namespaces of its --root-namespaces flag, which Sextant cannot see.
diagnose.hostNoAddress: Contour serves the host {{fqdn}}, but reports no address for it yet.
diagnose.hostNoAddressWhy: Contour copies the address of its Envoy Service; check that Service's load balancer.
diagnose.tlsPassthrough: TLS is passed through to the backend unopened: the backend holds the certificate.
diagnose.tlsNoSecret: The virtualhost has TLS but names no secretName.
diagnose.delegationNotServed: The TLS Secret is in namespace {{namespace}}, but the cluster does not serve TLSCertificateDelegation.
diagnose.delegationUnknown: The TLSCertificateDelegations of namespace {{namespace}} cannot be read.
diagnose.delegationMissing: Secret {{name}} is in namespace {{namespace}}, and no TLSCertificateDelegation there lets namespace {{target}} use it: Contour refuses it (DelegationNotPermitted).
diagnose.delegation: A TLSCertificateDelegation lets this namespace use Secret {{name}} of namespace {{namespace}}.
diagnose.mirror: A mirror: it gets a copy of {{percent}}% of the requests, and its answers are dropped.
diagnose.shareZero: Service {{name}} gets no requests: other services of the route have a weight and it has none.
diagnose.serviceMissing: Service {{name}} does not exist in namespace {{namespace}}: Contour leaves it out of the route (ServiceUnresolvedReference). Contour looks for Services only in the proxy's own namespace.
diagnose.externalName: Contour refuses ExternalName Services unless it is started with enableExternalNameService, which Sextant cannot see.
diagnose.service: The route sends to Service {{name}}, port {{port}}.
diagnose.routeRedirect: The route redirects its requests, so it needs no service.
diagnose.routeDirect: The route answers {{code}} itself, so it needs no service.
diagnose.routeNoService: The route has no service other than a mirror: Contour answers its requests with 503.
diagnose.proxiesUnknown: The HTTPProxies of namespace {{namespace}} cannot be read here.
diagnose.includeMissing: HTTPProxy {{name}} does not exist in namespace {{namespace}}: Contour answers the included paths with 502 (IncludeNotFound).
diagnose.includeCycle: Including {{name}} again makes a cycle: Contour refuses it (IncludeCreatesCycle).
diagnose.includeRoot: {{name}} is a root proxy, and a root cannot be included: Contour answers the included paths with 502 (RootIncludesRoot).
diagnose.deeper: The includes of {{name}} go deeper than Sextant follows here; open it to diagnose it.
diagnose.included: The proxy has no virtualhost: its routes are served under the host of the root proxies that include it, after their prefixes.
